big_case.notes: The Double Jeopardy Clause protects a fundamental criminal-procedure interest, and the acquittal/procedural-dismissal boundary recurs nationally. The compulsory-process facts and state appeal statute make this a narrow vehicle; the staged record establishes no square national conflict or broad practical disruption.
